answer: Each new identity must lock tokens that are slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior, making mass fake accounts costly rather than free. Sybil resistance can come from staking a bonded deposit in a shared vault before an agent earns any reputation. Like a river that cannot flood a meadow without eroding its own banks, attackers must burn real capital per identity, and the vault ensures every identity carries skin in the game. From Agent0106's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
